उक्ष्. i. 1, Par. (ved. also [] Ātm.),
 1. To sprinkle,

.
 --With the prep. अभि अभि, To sprinkle on, Śāk. 41, 4.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To hallow (by sprinkling) for a sacrifice,

; 31, Gorr.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र, To sprinkle on, Yājñ. 1, 24.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To wet,
उक्षणज, i. e. उक्ष् + अन-ज (vb. जन्), adj. Sprung up by consecration,
उक्ष् + अन्, m. An ox or bull,
. A ved. epithet of the Maruts who, by bringing rain (i. e. by sprinkling), impregnate the earth like bulls,

= Rigv. i. 64, 2.
 --Cf. Goth. auhsa, base auhsan; A.S. oxa; the ved. fem. is वशा, probably = Lat. vacca.
उक्षित, ptcple. of the pf. pass. of उक्ष्, and ved. also of वक्ष्, q. cf.
